review_comments.body: **Gemini defaults are undocumented** The Gemini defaults change, but the User Guide does not describe them. `CLAUDE.md` requires user-facing changes, explicitly including defaults, to be documented in the same PR. This requirement must be satisfied before merging. Update the cloud-provider section to name `gemini-3.8-flash` for chats and `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` for titles, and explain that an explicitly selected chat model stays unchanged. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**In-app help stays outdated** The new paragraph appears only in the Markdown. The generated in-app Providers page still omits it, so users reading in-app help will not see the new Gemini defaults. `CLAUDE.md` requires User Guide edits to be synced into the help artifacts. Run `pnpm edit-docs:sync-docs` and commit the resulting changes before merging. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
